t: Amazon + Manufacturer Disintermediation & The Shopify Squeeze
s: The AI landscape is evolving with infrastructure investments and data access debates, while businesses face disintermediation from manufacturers selling direct via Shopify, squeezed between giants like Amazon. Survival hinges on added human context and specialized customer experiences.
